ssoProfileDeletedEvent.description: Event occurred when SSO Profile deleted in customer's account

ssoProfileCreatedEvent.description: Event occurred when SSO Profile created in customer's account

eventTime.description: The time at which event occurred

isInternal.description: If `true`, the email originated from within the organization.

maliciousEntity.description: The entity whose actions triggered a Gmail phishing alert.

messages.description: The list of messages contained by this alert.

PhishingSpike.description: Alert for a spike in user reported phishing. *Warning*: This type has been deprecated. Use [MailPhishing](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/alertcenter/reference/rest/v1beta1/MailPhishing) instead.

previousAdminEmail.description: Email of person who was the primary admin before the action

updatedAdminEmail.description: Email of person who is the primary admin after the action

PrimaryAdminChangedEvent.description: Event occurred when primary admin changed in customer's account. The event are being received from insight forwarder

DriveSyncStateChanged.description: Alerts for when a user is restricted from syncing content from clients such as Drive for Desktop.

syncStateChangeReason.description: The reason for the sync state change.
enumDescriptions: Sync state was changed due to unusual activity, such as potential ransomware
The user provided feedback indicating that the initial sync state change may have been caused by unexpected activity
The user provided feedback indicating that the initial sync state change may have been caused by a false positive

syncPauseStartTime.description: Time at which sync was paused.

deviceProperty.description: The device property which was changed.

oldValue.description: The old value of the device property before the change.

iosVendorId.description: Required for iOS, empty for others.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the device.

newValue.description: The new value of the device property after the change.

SuspiciousActivitySecurityDetail.description: Detailed information of a single MDM suspicious activity event.

appleId.description: The Apple ID used to create the certificate. It may be blank if admins didn't enter it.

expirationTime.description: The expiration date of the APNS certificate.

ApnsCertificateExpirationInfo.description: The explanation message associated with "APNS certificate is expiring soon" and "APNS certificate has expired" alerts.

query.description: Alert Rule query Sample Query query { condition { filter { expected_application_id: 777491262838 expected_event_name: "indexable_content_change" filter_op: IN } } conjunction_operator: OR }

alertDetails.description: Any other associated alert details, for example, AlertConfiguration.

ReportingRule.description: Alerts from Reporting Rules configured by Admin.

entities.description: List of entities affected by the alert.

headers.description: Headers of the values in entities. If no value is defined in Entity, this field should be empty.

name.description: Name of the key detail used to display this entity list.

EntityList.description: EntityList stores entities in a format that can be translated to a table in the Alert Center UI.

suspensionDetails.description: Details about why an account is being suspended.

appealWindow.description: The amount of time remaining to appeal an imminent suspension. After this window has elapsed, the account will be suspended. Only populated if the account suspension is in WARNING state.

enumDescriptions: Customer is receiving a warning about imminent suspension.
Customer is being notified that their account has been suspended.
Customer is being notified that their suspension appeal was approved.
Customer has submitted their appeal, which is pending review.

AccountSuspensionWarning.description: A warning that the customer's account is about to be suspended.

justificationReason.description: Justification for data access based on justification enums.

scope.description: Scope of access, also known as a resource. This is further narrowed down by the product field.

requestId.description: ID of the Access Approvals request. This is a helpful field when requesting support from Google.

tickets.description: Support tickets related to this Access Approvals request. Populated if there is an associated case number.

products.description: Products within scope of the Access Approvals request.

officeLocation.description: Office location of Google staff requesting access such as "US".

AccessApproval.description: Alert that is triggered when Google support requests to access customer data.

SupportTicket.description: Support ticket related to Access Approvals request

Empty.description: A generic empty message that you can re-use to avoid defining duplicated empty messages in your APIs. A typical example is to use it as the request or the response type of an API method. For instance: service Foo { rpc Bar(google.protobuf.Empty) returns (google.protobuf.Empty); }

IdentityProviderError.description: Error related to an identity provider.

errorInfo.description: Info on the identity provider error.
enumDescriptions: Email in the ID token is different from the user's email.
Discovery URL did not contain all the necessary information.
URL for client-side encryption configuration content was unreachable.
Client-side encryption .well-known URL did not contain all the necessary information.
ID token returned by the identity provider is invalid.
Authentication token has no "email" or "google_email" claim.

authorizationBaseUrl.description: Authorization base url of the identity provider.

description: Manages alerts on issues affecting your domain. Note: The current version of this API (v1beta1) is available to all Google Workspace customers.
